d:
Ek navanbar ko dilli ke ramlila maidan men indiya blok ki raili huee. divali ke tyohar ke bich aayojit is raili ko lekar vyaparik sangathnon ne chinta jataee thi. unka kahna tha ki isse dilli ke bazaron aur karobar par asar par sakta hai. bibisi sanvaddata shubh rana ne sadar bazar, chandni chauk aur jama masjid ke ilakon men jakar vyapariyon se bat ki aur janne ki koshish ki ki raili ke din karobar par kitna asar para.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
